svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: repo-onboarding scans a repository into a generated block in AGENTS.md, the onboard skill adds architecture and conventions, CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md, and when the code changes the check command warns at session start and fails CI until update refreshes the block
svg.title: How repo-onboarding works
svg.text: Facts come from the repository, judgment comes from the agent, drift gets caught
every agent reads the same guidance

g.text: init reads manifests, lockfiles, CI and folders. Nothing in the repo runs.
Facts become a generated block in AGENTS.md: commands, layout, env vars, CI
The onboard skill adds what needs judgment: architecture, conventions, gotchas
CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md, so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read the same thing
Weeks later the lint script becomes check and a folder moves
check catches the drift: the agent hears it at session start, CI fails the PR
update rewrites only the generated block. Your own text stays as written.
